text.description_html:
22" Track Stainless Steel Barn Door Extension Kit

This Stainless Steel Barn Door Track Extension Kit comes with a 22 inch stainless steel track and the 15041 wall mount. It is made out of marine grade stainless steel so you can be sure it will withstand the test of time, just like the unfailing appeal of the barn door itself.

Features and Specifications of the Modern Stainless Steel 22" Barn Door Track Extension Kit:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • All 316 Marine Grade Stainless Steel Construction.
  • Track Length: 22"
  • Track Diameter: 1"
  • AHI DELTA-99D Specifications Diagram (PDF)

Package Includes:

  • 1 Stainless Steel 22" Tubular Track
  • Wall Mount
  • All necessary installation hardware.

Special Order Item. NOT Returnable.
